64: The core realization in these practices is that being readable, reusable, and testable are all side effects of writing modular code, i.e., of building programs out of short, single-purpose functions with clearly-defined inputs and outputs [12]. Much has been written on this topic [12–14], and this section focuses on practices that best balance ease of use with benefit for you and collaborators.
